What's your return and refund policy?
Please bear with me while I check our return and refund policy.
Great question—returns do come with a small novel’s worth of fine print. Online purchases must be returned within 30 days of delivery/collection, with a valid order reference. Items must be unworn, unwashed, unaltered, and tagged.
International: Store Credit equal to each item’s purchase price; no cash, delivery-fee, or customs-duty/tax refunds. Processing: within 14 business days of drop-off.
U.S. orders created on or before 14 October 2025: refund to the original payment method within 7–10 business days of drop-off.
Excluded: inner wear, jewelry, swimwear, accessories, lifestyle items, gifts, marked-down items, promo-code purchases whose terms prohibit returns, and giveaway/contest items.
